tagline: Global leader in nonperforming loan acquisition, collection and management
hero_kpi_rationale: Portfolio income is the key performance indicator reflecting the company's ability to generate stable and predictable revenue from its investments in nonperforming loans.

kpis.name: Portfolio Income
kpis.description: Portfolio income is the key performance indicator reflecting the ability to generate revenue from loan investments

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income adjusted for non-recurring transactions and impairments
kpis.description: Adjusted net income is a key indicator of company profitability, excluding non-recurring items
kpis.signal: Positive adjusted net income despite operational challenges

kpis.name: Estimated Remaining Collections
kpis.explanation: Estimation of cash collections remaining at fiscal year end
kpis.description: Estimated remaining collections represent the company's future cash potential from its portfolios
kpis.signal: Significant increase in future collections potential

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: EBITDA adjusted excluding goodwill impairments and non-recurring items
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA is a key indicator of the company's operating profitability
kpis.signal: Strong adjusted EBITDA growth demonstrating operational improvement

kpis.name: Adjusted Cash Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of gross cash less adjusted operating expenses over gross cash
kpis.description: Adjusted cash efficiency ratio measures the portion of cash retained after operating expenses
kpis.signal: Improvement in cash efficiency ratio demonstrating better cost management

kpis.name: Return on Average Tangible Equity
kpis.description: ROATE measures profitability relative to average tangible shareholder equity
kpis.signal: Significant decline due to net loss and non-recurring impairments

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL across the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $1.202B in latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL across the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of -$0.305B in latest fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT incidents
risks.score_rationale: The risk is addressed in detail in the 10-K, with strong language on foreseeable threats and potential impacts. Integrated into the enterprise risk management framework and regularly reported to the board risk committee. Highly critical category in the specialized financial services sector.

risks.title: Litigation and regulatory proceedings
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of debt collection-related litigation, including class actions. Recurring risk in daily operations, with high potential for financial and reputational impact. Present every year without notable mitigation.

risks.title: Third-party vendor dependence
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes third-party vendor assessment within the cybersecurity framework, as well as their critical role in operations. Failure by a third party could disrupt systems or lead to data breaches.

risks.title: Complex regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K mentions a fragmented regulatory environment in Europe and complex conditions in the United States. Risk is elevated due to the number of jurisdictions and the sensitive nature of collection activities.

risks.title: Portfolio acquisition price fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The document notes an increase in purchase price multiples (PPMs) due to favorable market conditions. This threatens future profitability if competition or supply shifts.

risks.title: Declining stock performance
risks.score_rationale: The chart shows a 55% decline in stock value between 2020 and 2025, though not a direct operational risk. This affects market perception and ability to raise capital.

risks.title: US operational restructuring
risks.score_rationale: The 40% reduction in US call center headcount is a major change. While accompanied by increased collections, it carries execution and skill loss risks.

ai_positioning.summary: PRAA does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
